title: Aokigahara reconstruction geospatial layer stack
core_rule: No single polygon is labelled “the exact Aokigahara boundary”. Forest, lava, natural-monument, national-park, administrative and research extents remain separate.

alignment.authoring_crs: EPSG:6676 (JGD2011 / Japan Plane Rectangular CS VIII) unless a later production decision standardises another metric CRS
alignment.source_datum_warning: Current GSI downloadable elevation data may be JGD2024; normalise datum/vertical reference explicitly before asset placement.
